verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-definable event-to-action rules engine in Lambda. The support-ticket webhooks only notify an external URL, so they are a building block for the user's own automation rather than rules that trigger actions. Firewall rules are static traffic filters, and MK8s node remediation and Slurm scheduling are vendor-managed behaviors, not user-defined event rules. Community reports also show users asking for auto-stop, with no such capability documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
